links.outcome: Guideline adherence of LLM outputs with vs without RAG grounding
links.effect: Adherence 81.7% GPT-4o without RAG vs 97.2% with RAG; 79.3% o1-mini without RAG vs 95.1% with RAG (P < .05).
links.quote: Adherence rates were 81.7% for GPT-4o without RAG, 97.2% for GPT-4o with RAG, 79.3% for o1-mini without RAG, and 95.1% for o1-mini with RAG.

links.outcome: Reading ease and grade level of LLM outputs
links.effect: RAG improved reading ease and lowered grade level, but all model outputs remained at advanced comprehension levels.
links.quote: RAG-enabled models demonstrated improved reading ease and lower grade level scores; however, all model outputs remained at advanced comprehension levels.
